maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The four keypoints in the top row are aligned parallel to the primary dense row below, with a vertical separation distance approximately equal to 1.5 times the average diameter of a single vibrissa spot.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium shows approximately 95% melanin saturation, with a deep black pigment covering the entire apex and only faint, lower-contrast pixels visible at the extreme dorsal edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct cluster of dark, high-contrast spots is visible on the lower posterior cheek and neck region, separate from the primary maxillary vibrissae patterns.
